title: 第2章 威龙：游戏主播？我吗？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“没想到我第一个招募的干员竟然是威龙，这下稳了！”

如果三角洲哪一个的干员的热度最高，毫无疑问就是威龙了。

进可当威风的龙，退可成贪吃的猪。

那响彻零号大坝的C4声无疑是最好的证明！

“系统，快帮我把威龙召唤出来吧！”

来到了家里客厅比较宽敞的位置，林修便对系统下达了召唤指令。

下一秒，

只见一道白光闪过，

一个比起游戏中五官线条更为清晰，气质更为硬朗男人以立正姿态出现在了他的面前！

“事贵应机，准备突入！”

“王宇昊，前来报道！”

没有任何对眼下陌生环境的惊疑，一切以执行长官命令为最优先。

果然不愧是‘特战’干员，专业素质就是强！

“放轻松些，威龙干员，我现在并没有什么紧急的突击任务需要你去完成。”

林修相信，以对方的观察能力，恐怕早就已经通过窗外的一片和谐确认了两人当下的处境。

但由于自己接下来要颁布的任务属实有些雷人，他也还是需要好好组织一下语言，然后再跟对方说明。

.....

“所以，长官的意思，我接下来的行动是去游玩这一款以我们为模板创作的枪战游戏？”

“而且还是开着直播去玩？”

“我、我不行的！我从来没玩过游戏，这种东西还是晓雯更擅长吧？”

半个小时后，通过林修各种的好说歹说。

威龙才终于从那种即将要出任务，以及面对最高长官的认真状态脱离了出来，

现在他的状态就是日常和队友们相处时候的样子，比较平和，性格很好。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"I didn't expect that the first operator I recruited would be Weilong. Now it's stable!"

If there is any operator in Delta that is the most popular, it is undoubtedly Veyron.

If you advance, you can become a majestic dragon; if you retreat, you can become a greedy pig.

The C4 sound that resounded through Dam Zero is undoubtedly the best proof!

"System, please help me summon Weilong!"

Arriving at a relatively spacious place in the living room at home, Lin Xiu issued a summoning command to the system.

The next second,

I saw a flash of white light,

A man with clearer facial features and a tougher temperament than in the game appeared in front of him standing at attention!

"When the situation arises, prepare to break in!"

"Wang Yuhao, come and report!"

There was no doubt about the strange environment at hand, and the execution of the commander's orders was the top priority.

As expected, he is worthy of being a ‘special operations’ operator, and his professionalism is strong!

"Relax, Operator Weilong, I don't have any urgent assault missions that you need to complete right now."

Lin Xiu believed that with the other party's observation ability, he might have already confirmed the current situation of the two through the harmony outside the window.

But since the task he was about to enact was a bit ridiculous, he still needed to organize his language well before explaining it to the other party.

.....

"So, sir, what do you mean, my next action is to play this gun battle game based on our model?"

"And you're still going to play with the live broadcast on?"

"I-I can't do it! I've never played games before. Is Xiaowen better at this kind of thing?"

Half an hour later, Lin Xiu made various good and bad remarks.

Weilong finally got out of the serious state of being about to go on a mission and facing the highest officer.

His current state is the same as when he gets along with his teammates every day. He is relatively peaceful and has a good personality.
